topic: How does the dual-mode operation of the CTS antenna impact frequency reuse and coverage patterns in Ka-band satellite architectures?
consensus_response: Dual-mode CTS antennas enhance frequency reuse via polarization diversity, improving spectral efficiency. However, this increases interference susceptibility due to smaller beam spots. Beamforming optimization techniques can mitigate interference while maintaining capacity gain, introducing trade-offs between capacity and resource allocation.
reference_context: Ka-band satellite systems offer higher bandwidths, but are susceptible to weather conditions, impacting link quality and end-users' QoS.
